page: Microsoft Azure D8d_v4 is a general-purpose virtual machine belonging to the DDv4 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture powered by an Intel Xeon 8272CL processor operating at 2.6 GHz. The configuration includes 8 dedicated vCPUs derived from 4 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. Memory capacity stands at 32.0 GB, providing 4.0 GB of RAM per core. This instance is equipped with 307 GB of local SSD storage, while offering zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Benchmark evaluations place the D8d_v4 in the average performance tier across most compute and memory operations. The Intel Xeon processor supports AVX-512 and AVX-512 VNNI instructions, contributing to a Passmark CPU score of 8537.82 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 4751.0. Memory read bandwidth for small cached blocks reaches 414.44 GB/sec, while large uncached block reads and writes operate at 46.63 GB/sec and 34.22 GB/sec respectively. Redis SET operations perform at an average rate of 7.06 million operations per second, and static web serving throughput is measured at 6.77 GB/sec.

A notable performance limitation is observed in compression and decompression tasks, where single-threaded gzip compression (23.73 GB/sec) and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression (27.25 GB/sec) both score in the weak tier. The server is suited for general-purpose workloads, database operations, and moderate web serving tasks that benefit from local SSD storage but do not require intensive data compression.
